sessions.phase_label: Primary and secondary CAD layer revisions

requirements.title: Primary Layer Revisions
requirements.definition: Apply the client-supplied edits to the primary CAD layer and provide the updated artifact for review.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the primary layer revision deliverable; the secondary layer has its own revisions and can be reviewed or changed independently.

requirements.title: Secondary Layer Revisions
requirements.definition: Apply the client-supplied revisions to the secondary CAD layer and provide the updated artifact.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the secondary layer revision deliverable; it remains separate because the client supplies secondary revisions independently from primary edits.
